defeating_case_coverage.verdict: Six consequential behaviours the artifact's own prose asserts have no case that proves the required refusal. Under the witness procedure a claim with no defeating fixture is unwitnessable, and these are claims the member's note and the modules' own docstrings make.

verdict: DISSENT. BUILT -> WITNESSED is not supported for custody:phase-1-5/definition-recurrence at 6d02eef.
verdict_reasoning: The four repairs are real and I reproduced all four. The reader is better at 6d02eef than at any prior revision on this branch: the self-check now sees the title rule it certifies, the split test can fail, the registered check reads the collection it declares, the module split lost no rule, and I constructed the case where the clause is legitimately satisfied and confirmed the new reachability code does not pin a failing verdict in either direction. If the question were whether the repairs were made, the answer is yes. That is not the question. Three things refuse this revision, and the first is the reason the other two matter. First, the commit repaired findings without re-deriving the findings' own premises, and the central premise was false. Pass 5 reported that reinstating the title defect left scripts/verify.py green and that verify runs selfcheck and not the unit tests. Neither is true. verify.py runs scripts/tests/test_sov_recurrence.py in tooling shard 4/4, and at 1ce4d21 the plant takes verify to exit 1 with exactly one failing check. Deleting the custody collection at 1ce4d21 also failed a unit test that reads the live repository, so verify was not blind to the clause's reachability either. The commit message asserts both falsehoods, and the second is now sentence 24 of a governed contract file as 'which it did not before'. This is the branch's own defect class - a claim about what a check reads, asserted rather than measured - committed by the commit written to repair it, and it is why the repository's rule that a report is not evidence is not a formality. Second, the withdrawal that mattered most did not land where it mattered. The corrections block on the pass-4 record is exemplary. Sentence 17 of the custody note inverts both of its own clauses, so the file a reader of the custody collection actually opens still asserts that pass 4 came from a different model family. Independence is the entire content of the transition being asked for. Third, and this is the finding I would not want absorbed quietly: the certification the W5-F1 repair achieved covers one prose key of five. Reading `description` as a declaration leaves selfcheck at 0, all 32 unit tests passing, and python scripts/verify.py at exit 0 with PASS: 57 checks - and one added description sentence then takes the live reading from nine of ten to ten of ten resolved. That is the exact defect pass 4 refused e898d06 for, moved from `title` to `description` rather than removed, and it is fully invisible. Alongside it the trap-T3 defence the reader cites by name has no defeating case, and its regression admits a NOT_WITNESSED member into the settled basis with nothing red. A reader whose stated purpose is to keep prose out of a graded verdict cannot be witnessed while its gate certifies that property for one of the seven keys it denies, and while the sentence in the governed file describing what the gate now reaches is false. Each finding is individually small and individually repairable inside this concern. None is a seam and none needs another tier.
standing_supported: NONE. This observation supports no standing transition. The member stays BUILT at work_state PRESENTED. Six independent readings now exist and none has supported BUILT -> WITNESSED.
residuals: The custody note calls the six readings independent without qualification. Five of the six, including this one, share the builder's container, working tree and model family and read a prompt written inside the build chain. 'Independent' here means only 'did not build the change', which is the repository's own standard, but a reader of the collection alone will read more into it than the records support.

Sentence 16's container and root-seat-prompt claims for pass 4 rest on the same unverifiable self-report as the model claim that was withdrawn. The asymmetry is deliberate and pass 5 endorsed it; it is recorded so it is not later mistaken for corroborated fact.
contracts/custodies/phase-1-5.json records this member at work_state PRESENTED while the 1ce4d21 commit message says it 'is landed at BUILT'. Not this commit's claim and not graded here.
scripts/verify.py exits 0 at 6d02eef and records wall-clock and budget debt only. CLAUDE.md trap T2: that means unchanged, not qualified, and it says nothing about P15-Q4 against this repository.
The reported closure in contracts/product-canon.schema.json remains reported. W5-F7 named the reason and the note now states it; W6-F3 shows nothing measures that it stays that way.
judgement_items: None of the findings above is judgement-typed. All seven material findings are repairable inside this concern by the participant that holds it, at effect class RECORD_LOCAL, without widening any grant. This observation asks Bdo for nothing.

One question is worth putting to the seat one edge up rather than absorbed: after six readings, five of them from inside the builder's container and model family, is a further reading from the same position capable of settling this member's independence at all, or does BUILT -> WITNESSED here now require a reading this host cannot produce? That is a question about what evidence would suffice, not a request for permission to continue.
